findings.summary: "7d" preset was not fixed and still spans 8 days, contradicting the stated fix and the task brief's explicit example.
findings.mechanism: The comment states daysAgo(N) spans N+1 days and 30d/90d are correctly changed to daysAgo(29)/daysAgo(89), but the "7d" entry is left as daysAgo(7), which per the same logic yields an inclusive 8-day window (today plus 7 days back) instead of the required 7 days — the exact off-by-one the task brief called out as the motivating bug ("Last 7 days should span exactly 7 days, not 8").
